anomalies.observed: On sheet 1, the pH and EC ADM3260 isolators have both their primary-side and secondary-side I2C pins tied to the same global labels as the ESP32 main I2C bus. U9 pins 17/18 and 3/2, and U7 pins 17/18 and 3/2, all carry NET0061/NET0097; M6A IO4/I2C_SDA and IO5/I2C_SCL also carry NET0061/NET0097.
anomalies.expected: The specification requires the pH and EC circuits to be behind separate galvanically isolated I2C domains, with isolated-domain pairs such as /SDA_pH/SCL_pH and /SDA_EC/SCL_EC, not connected to the main I2C bus.

evidence.quote: Sheet 1, pH Sensor: U9 ADM3260 pins 17/18 and 3/2 are labeled NET0061/NET0097
Sheet 1, Electro Conductivity Sensor: U7 ADM3260 pins 17/18 and 3/2 are labeled NET0061/NET0097
Sheet 1, SoC: M6A IO4/I2C_SDA and IO5/I2C_SCL are labeled NET0061/NET0097
Two Atlas Scientific EZO circuits (pH, EC) each sit behind a dedicated 2.5 kV galvanically-isolated I2C bridge (ADM3260, U3/U4)

anomalies.impact: The isolation barrier is defeated. The wet pH/EC probe I2C lines and their isolated domains are shorted to the main digital I2C bus, eliminating the intended ground-loop/noise protection and potentially damaging the probes or controller.

anomalies.observed: Sheet 1, Water Height Sensor section shows PR5 LiDAR wired to H6: VCC to +5V, SDA/SCL to NET0061/NET0097, and GND to GND.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that the TF-Luna LiDAR is not wired (pins free, on_board: no, excluded from the board) and that the wired water-level sensor is an HC-SR04-style ultrasonic sensor on two GPIOs.

evidence.quote: Sheet 1, Water Height Sensor: PR5 LiDAR pins are connected to H6 labels NET0061 and NET0097
TF-Luna LiDAR module (PR1) ... its pins are free and it is marked on_board: no / excluded from the board; it is not wired into any net

anomalies.impact: An unintended LiDAR is loaded on the main I2C bus, changing bus behavior and replacing the specified ultrasonic water-level interface.

parsed.summary: The drawing contains a clear isolation defect: both ADM3260 pH/EC I2C bridges have their isolated and non-isolated I2C pins tied to the same NET0061/NET0097 labels, bypassing the required galvanic isolation. The LiDAR is also drawn wired to the I2C bus although the specification says it is unwired.
